nodes.name: From Hub-Dispatcher (lead.booked)
nodes.notes: S4.3 -- ab 1.5 ise seedha nahi bulata. 1.5 apna stage-change 'lead.booked' event Hub-Intake ko report karta hai (funnel_events row), aur Hub-Dispatcher har 2 min me poll karke is workflow ko Execute Workflow se call karta hai, funnel_events row ka pura item pass karte hue -- isliye input shape Hub-Intake ke trigger jaisa hi hai (event_type, client_id, odoo_lead_id, source_module, payload). Sirf odoo_lead_id neeche use hota hai, baaki fields traceability ke liye available hain.

parameters.query: SELECT * FROM clients_master WHERE odoo_lead_id = {{$json.odoo_lead_id}} LIMIT 1;

nodes.name: Parse + Decide Simple vs Custom
nodes.notes: PROPOSAL_CUSTOM_THRESHOLD_INR se zyada value wale deals ke liye custom-branded PDF (Gotenberg), chhote deals ke liye seedha Odoo Sales Quotation (simple, fast).

nodes.name: Odoo - Create Sales Quotation (Simple)
nodes.notes: partner_id zaroori hai -- clients_master me abhi odoo_partner_id column nahi hai (Setup section 1 me ALTER TABLE diya hai), tab tak ODOO_FALLBACK_PARTNER_ID env var use hoti hai.

nodes.name: Build Portal Link (Simple)
nodes.notes: Portal link direct access ke liye Odoo customer portal par lead ka contact already invited/valid hona chahiye, ya login-less access_token read karke URL me add karna hoga (v2).

nodes.name: Gotenberg - HTML to PDF
nodes.notes: Gotenberg ko file field 'index.html' chahiye -- is node se pehle ek Code/Set node se binary 'index_html' bana lena hoga jiska filename index.html ho (n8n binary conversion step, standard Gotenberg pattern).

parameters.subject: ={{$json.proposal_title}}

nodes.name: Send Proposal Email (Postal SMTP)
nodes.notes: Accept link Module 2.5 ke 'Proposal Accept Webhook' ko point karta hai -- yahi se Contract + E-sign flow shuru hota hai. | MERGED (Phase 0): ab HMAC-signed proposal_accept_url use karta hai (3.0.1 security patch), inline lead_id link nahi.

parameters.query:
UPDATE clients_master
SET status = 'Proposal Sent',
    proposal_url = '{{$json.proposal_url}}',
    updated_at = now()
WHERE odoo_lead_id = {{$json.odoo_lead_id}};

nodes.name: Report to Hub
nodes.notes: S4.3 -- Postgres - Mark Proposal Sent ke baad event_type: proposal.sent report karta hai. Abhi Hub-Dispatcher ke Switch me iske liye koi branch wired nahi hai (2.5 abhi bhi apne 'Proposal Accept Webhook' se hi trigger hota hai, is event se nahi) -- isliye ye flagged_events me girega, jaise 1.3's lead.captured, jab tak koi module isse subscribe na kare. Traceability + future-use ke liye report karna zaroori hai, taaki funnel_events me har hop dikhe.

nodes.name: Security - Build Accept URL Base
nodes.notes: Phase 3.0.1 glue step (not in original 5 patch files). Both 'Build Portal Link (Simple)' and 'Build Share Link (Custom)' branches feed here before token generation, since the accept link must exist regardless of simple/custom proposal path.

nodes.name: Security - Generate HMAC Accept Token
nodes.notes: 3.0.1.1. Token = lead_id.expiry_unix.signature, 7-day expiry. Needs env var PROPOSAL_ACCEPT_HMAC_SECRET (new).

nodes.name: Security - Append HMAC Token to Accept URL
nodes.notes: 3.0.1.2. Output field: proposal_accept_url -- this is what 'Send Proposal Email' now uses instead of the old inline ?lead_id= link.

main.node: Security - Append HMAC Token to Accept URL
